compatibility_findings.locator: source lines 27-49; archive file listing; README table and final paragraphs
compatibility_findings.finding: inputfile.txt is required but absent from the listed archive. Velocity alone does not identify each raw row's rheology or full case; 1 cm/year movie cases are not present in the u array. Preserve the empty 10 cm/year row as missing, not zero.

The stored diagnostic integrates tau_xx minus tau_zz over a plate-interior column. Establish its sign, integration support, time units, boundary-work relation, initial zero and row-to-panel mapping; the README shorthand T1_rec*u omits the time-unit conversion. Figure 7 names and panel labels also contain repetition.

Source algebra resolves the effective activation energy as 540*1400/1500=504 kJ/mol. Whether this law produced the intended published case remains unresolved; do not silently correct it and call the result a reproduction.

Required morbphase.txt is absent from the archive listing. It supplies incoming basalt density. The cited Hacker, Abers and Peacock 2003 paper (10.1029/2001JB001127) does not establish the exact numerical table.

compatibility_findings.locator: paper section 3 and Table 1; source lines 743-750, 781-817
compatibility_findings.finding: Paper uses friction coefficient mu=0.6 in mu*p+C; script uses angle phi=0.6 rad in C*cos(phi)+p*sin(phi), with different weakening. Initial source pressure coefficient is 0.5646424734 and cohesion contribution 36.314767 MPa before clipping. Do not equate or silently convert these laws.

compatibility_findings.locator: article-linked ggac332_supplemental_file.pdf S2 pages 2-3 and Figure S5 page 7; source lines 659-664
compatibility_findings.finding: S2 links Figure 4c to elastic timestep approximately numerical timestep; Figure S5 caption links it to the 1 Myr panel rather than the 1.5 kyr panel. Archived script implies approximately 1.057 Myr. Published-case convention remains unresolved.

The source accumulates the total symmetric strain-rate second invariant while yielding. Atlas accumulates resolved plastic engineering shear. There is no general constant-factor conversion between these histories.

The stopstep branch assigns zero horizontal velocity at the right boundary. This is not removal of driving traction. A reaction-force zero or a fixed-force case also does not establish Atlas's unforced continuation test.

Numerical histories remove digitisation error, not mesh/time/solver error or model mismatch. Define compatible case profiles, sampling support, numerical uncertainty and force/work allowances before an Atlas candidate run.

replacement_source_review.next_action: Source/code reconstruction of the 4 cm/year row is retained, but exact published-case completion now needs missing inputfile.txt and morbphase.txt plus raw-row/rheology provenance and reconciliation of published/code conventions.
